scope: Rest-pose planned twig tips against live High near leaf triangles. surfaceLowerWorld is the minimum distance to any full triangle, ignoring alpha; opaqueUpperWorld is distance to a witnessed opaque point (closest-point alpha test, otherwise a 48-step barycentric grid, seeded by audit samples). These bound the true distance but do not identify a detached component or prove player-visible separation. Largest-scale instance per shared hero template. World distances use the uniform instance scale. No production geometry edits.
